hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Hook that charges a 1.7% fee on each swap: buy-side fees accumulate in an ETH pot for periodic buyback-and-burn (triggered every 20 swaps), while sell-side token fees are immediately queued for burning. Liquidity addition is permanently restricted to one deposit, and exact-output swaps always revert. When the token's `timeBased` flag is set, sell-side swaps are additionally restricted to an owner-approved allowlist (the `hasValue` mapping), reverting for any seller not on the list.
